contexts.text: To hang both ways is not allowed.
Lest they should hang between evils and goods. AC 4424.
He would then hang between Heaven and Hell. AC 5433:2. AC 5835:2. AC 7039:end. AC 7180.

He shall pay silver according to the dowry of virgins () = other truth consenting in its place... To pay = substitution in the place of the former; for he who pays a dowry, and does not take the virgin, gives something else for her.
It thus hung from it, and was tied to it; and to be tied to, and to hang, in the spiritual sense, = to inflow; because all conjunction in the Spiritual World... is effected by means of influx.
That the whole man be either in Heaven or in Hell, and may not hang between the two; that is, with his eye look to the things of Heaven, and with his heart to the things of Hell. See DLW 397.
As the subsidiary life of the body depends on the heart alone...
By tekel, or to weigh, is signified to know its quality as to good.
On the idea of God... everything of the Church depends.
On which faith each and all things of the present Church depend.
He would become like one hanging in the air.
I saw human bodies... hanging down and inanimate. SE 3912:end.
He appeared pendent in the midst...
He was held hanging in that flame...
She appeared pendent, like a kind of spectre.
She was not yet ripe; which they found out by the fact that she hung like something aerial; and was thus carried to and fro.
In the life of the body they had thought nothing steadily; but had hung both ways...
Weighed in the balances () = estimation according to their quality; and judgment.
To weigh () = to estimate and ordinate according to their quality.
